summary: An 'Introducing' article on Lost Type's own Craft CMS site for Dotties Vanilla (sans) and Dotties Chocolate (slab), told entirely through an ice-cream-parlour world: illustrated characters, pint tubs and glyph-shaped popsicles. Almost every specimen is a pre-rendered SVG/PNG served per breakpoint; only the section headings and paragraphs are live text, and there is no tester or buy flow on the page, just 'Try Dotties' links to the font page. Capture note: the whole article came out as one 7748px block (02), so all content instances below share that block.

instances.look: Thin light-grey status bar: 'Welcome to Lost Type! You're previewing the latest version of our site. For technical questions and feedback, please contact us.'

instances.variantDefinition: A persistent site navigation bar (name or logo plus links or view tabs, sometimes utility toggles such as colour themes), top or bottom, fixed or static; it navigates rather than introducing the font.
instances.look: The foundry's standard header (not specimen-specific): white bar, navy Lost Type badge logo at left, 'Fonts Store Blog Contact About' small links at right

On white, 'Dotties Vanilla &' in teal over 'Dotties Chocolate' in pink, both heavy and wide; below, 'Introducing Dotties: A type family designed to swirl together.' in navy slab at left and three illustrated friends strolling with ice-cream cones at right
instances.learn: Give each subfamily a flavour and a colour (Vanilla = teal, Chocolate = pink) and keep that code for the whole page

reconstruction.layout: Title SVG spanning the max-width-8 container (~1200px wide, ~200px tall, two lines); then a two-column figure: caption col-6 left (max-width-2 text, ~380px) and illustration col-6 right (~640×380px), vertically centred
reconstruction.typography: Title lettering in Dotties Chocolate Black, wide, ~100px cap-to-cap lines, teal then pink (pre-rendered SVG); intro heading ~36px 'LT Introducing Headline' (Dotties Chocolate Black) navy, line-height ~1.1; credit lines ~16px 'LT Introducing Text' (Dotties Vanilla Regular) with bold names
reconstruction.behaviour: none; <picture> swaps Landscape/Mobile SVG versions of the title per breakpoint
reconstruction.content: Family pair name; 'Designed by Kyle Letendre. Now Serving exclusively at Lost Type.'
reconstruction.html: article > .introducing-font-family-text > figure > picture > source[media] ×4 + img; figure.sm-flex > .sm-col-6.order-last img + .sm-col-6 figcaption > h3.introducing-font-family-headline

instances.look: On a deep indigo band, three shelves of illustrated ice-cream pints, 18 tubs each with an invented flavour label in a different Dotties style ('UMAMI OOHPAPI', 'Lawful Waffle', 'Marvelous Mr. Meringue', 'Milkiest Magician', 'Velvety Smooth', 'Thoroughly THIQUE'…)
instances.learn: Packaging pastiche lets every tub test a different weight, width and pairing while the puns keep it fun

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed band (#44468e), image max-width-9 (~1360px), ~720px tall; 6×3 grid of tubs on a lit shelf
reconstruction.typography: Labels in Dotties Vanilla and Chocolate across weights and italics, mixed with patterned label designs (pre-rendered)
reconstruction.content: Invented flavour names with taglines ('Savory and Saucy', 'Silky & Serene', 'Quench Queen')

instances.look: Repeated for each subfamily: a navy heading and short description beside 'a b c' set on three line-drawn hands holding cones; then a giant teal (or pink) 'a' with an illustrated woman leaning in its counter, beside a list of 20 style names each set in itself (Thin → Ultra, then Ultra Italic → Thin Italic) and an orange 'TRY DOTTIES' button; a sprinkles divider separates Vanilla from Chocolate
instances.ux: static images; 'Try Dotties' links to the font page
instances.learn: Run the style list down and back up (romans getting heavier, italics getting lighter) so the column swells and thins like a scoop

reconstruction.layout: Per subfamily ~1500px: two-column figure (text col-6 left ~380px measure, cones SVG col-6 right ~520×340px); full-width 'hero' SVG (~1200×600px): giant letter + character left half, style list right half; centred CTA; sprinkle divider image (~1200×20px) between subfamilies

reconstruction.content: Real subfamily descriptions ('a humanist sans serif with a twist… hand-painted signs'; 'a humanist slab serif: a ganache with panache') and the full style names
reconstruction.assets: Cone SVGs (LT_Dotties-04_VanillaCones.svg, -06_ChocolateCones.svg), hero SVGs with character illustration (-05_VanillaHero, -07_ChocolateHero, each with a -Mobile version), sprinkles divider PNG
reconstruction.html: figure.sm-flex > .order-last img + figcaption > h3 + div; figure > picture; a.btn.btn-primary[href=/fonts/dotties]

instances.look: On dark indigo, a 5×3 menu board of glossy popsicles shaped like glyphs and objects (a sun, '@', '&', lips, 'g', a rainbow, a heart, sunglasses), each tile topped with a product name in Dotties ('Bright Future', 'the Tangy Tammie', 'AmpedUp', 'TRICOUNTY tricolor', 'SHARI'S SHADES') and a starburst price sticker
instances.learn: A menu-board grid gives each style its own 'product' and price sticker: the specimen becomes something you want to order

instances.look: 'Designed to Swirl Together' heading and paragraph beside a cat licking a dropped cone; then a justified wall of famous pairs ('We go together like … Cup & Cone · Sonny & Cher · Lock & Key · Salt & Pepper … Vanilla & Chocolate'), each word switching between Vanilla and Chocolate, roman and italic, light and black, with an illustrated couple sharing ice cream
instances.learn: Demonstrate a pairing family with a list of famous pairs, alternating the two subfamilies word by word, so the theme and the pairing are the same idea
